instructions.name: close_game
docs: Closes a game with no active players (creator only)

instructions.name: complete_game
docs: Completes a game by revealing the secret key and distributing winnings

instructions.name: initialize_game
docs: Creates a new game with specified configuration

instructions.name: initialize_oracle
docs: Initializes the global oracle account with fee settings and constraints

instructions.name: initialize_token
docs: Initializes a new token for use in games with minimum amount and enabled status

instructions.name: join_game
docs: Allows a player to join an existing game

instructions.name: unjoin_game
docs: Allows a player to leave a game before completion (with refund)

instructions.name: update_oracle
docs: Updates oracle configuration including operator transfer

instructions.name: update_token
docs: Updates token configuration including minimum amounts and enabled status

instructions.name: withdraw_token_fee
docs: Allows oracle operator to withdraw accumulated fees for a token

docs: Whether this is a private game requiring oracle approval
